why does the swing desk hold 8 stocks and not 3?

It used to be 3. In the bot's own backtest from 2011 to 2026, momentum with 8 to 10 holdings traded about 3 times as often as with 3, made about the same, and had a smaller worst drop: roughly -42% to -47% instead of -57%. Spreading over more stocks also means each position is smaller (12.5% of the desk), so one bad stock hurts less. It's a backtest result, not a guarantee, but it's why the setting is 8.

whats on the trades tab

Trades shows how the chosen account is doing. How it's doing has tiles: Made / lost overall, Beat the S&P 500?, Trades finished, Win rate, Average win / loss, Money put into trades, Taken profit / on paper now, and Best / worst trade. Below are the Profit & loss calendar; Finished trades (filter All, Wins or Losses) with what it spent, got back, made or lost, and why it sold; Still holding; and Day by day, each day's value at the close and change. It works the same for in its head, paper and real money.

is the weekend crypto trading real

No: pretend money ($500) at real, live crypto prices from Alpaca's free crypto data. No order goes to any broker, so it can't mix with your Alpaca paper account's stocks. It uses the swing desk's momentum method on hourly bars, which was only ever tested on stocks, so treat it as an experiment. Turn it off in Setup → Settings → Weekend practice: crypto.

what's opening_range_breakout

A day-desk method. The first 30 minutes after the open set the day's opening range, and it has no opinion while that range forms. After that, it buys if the price breaks above the range's high and exits if the price falls back below the middle of the range. Like every day trade, anything still open is sold 10 minutes before the close.

what happens if i hit the pushover monthly limit

Kestrel keeps count of what it sends each month. Pushover's free sending limit is 10,000 messages a month, and once Kestrel has sent 9,500 it only sends urgent alerts (high and emergency priority), keeping the last 500 for those. Routine alerts like buys, sells and daily results are skipped until the next month. A skipped or failed alert never stops trading, and Telegram alerts aren't affected by this count.

when does the swing desk actually make its trades?

Once a day, 15 minutes before the close: 3:45pm New York time on a normal day, 12:45pm on early-close days. That's when it scores its stocks and places buys and sells. The rest of the trading day the autopilot still checks the swing positions every 5 minutes, but only for stop-losses. It decides near the close because its backtest decides and fills at each day's close, and the same code runs in testing, paper and live, so what was tested is what trades.

can i see the kestrel dashboard on my iphone

Yes, with Setup → Your phone → Kestrel screen on your iPhone. how big is a day trade?

Up to 33% of the day desk's money, but also small enough that hitting the stop loses no more than 0.66% of the desk. So the stop size sets the position. With $500: a 2% stop allows the full 33% (about $165); a 4% stop allows about 16.5% (about $82); a 1% stop is still capped at 33%. Either way the loss at the stop stays around $3.30 or less. It also keeps 1% of cash aside.

how does the swing desk decide what to buy

Right now (Stage 1) it uses momentum. At 3:45pm it lines up every stock it's considering, its watchlist plus up to 30 strong, affordable names from the daily scan, and ranks them by how much they rose over the past 12 months, leaving out the latest month. A stock in the top 20% that's also above its 200-day average is a buy, strongest first, while there are free slots (8 in total) and cash. If SPY itself is under its 200-day average, it holds what it has and buys nothing new.

how do i hook up webull?

Apply for API access on the Webull website (API Management → My Application); Webull reviews it in about 1-2 business days. Once approved, generate a key and paste the App Key and App Secret into Setup, choosing Paper for test-environment keys or Real money. Press Test Webull, then approve Kestrel in the Webull app within 5 minutes (Menu → Messages → OpenAPI Notifications → Check Now → the text-message code). The approval lapses after 15 unused days, so the autopilot uses it each morning.

why isn't it buying anything?

Several rules can stop new buys, and the after-market report lists the reason under its thinking. Common ones: all slots are full (8 swing, 3 day); SPY is below its 200-day average (momentum then buys nothing new); the desk is down more than 3% today; a strong stock has danger news or, on the swing desk, an earnings report within 3 trading days; the Risk agent is skipping a repeated mistake; the strategy has been paused by its own lessons; or it's the day desk's last 30 minutes. Sometimes nothing simply scores high enough.

how do i know if my mac fell asleep and kestrel stopped trading

Set up Setup → Your phone → Alert me if Kestrel stops. Kestrel checks in with healthchecks.io (free) every 5 minutes; if the check-ins stop because the Mac slept, lost power or internet, or Kestrel froze, healthchecks.io alerts your phone through Pushover, Telegram or email. It also alerts you if trading keeps failing for about 15 minutes while the Mac is on. A sleeping Mac can't warn you by itself, which is why the alert comes from outside.

how do i set up telegram alerts

In Setup → Your phone, under Telegram: alerts and commands: 1) In Telegram, open @BotFather, send /newbot and pick any name; it gives you a token. 2) Paste it into Bot token and press Save. 3) Setup then shows a message to send: /start followed by a 6-digit pairing code. Open your new bot and send exactly that. The tag changes to paired and Send a test message starts working. Only your phone is ever answered. The token is saved on your Mac in ~/AITrader/.env, and the autopilot has to be running to receive your messages.

skip the paper trading, i want to go straight to real money

Real money only opens after a desk has paper traded for at least 30 trading days, made money, beaten SPY over the same days and stayed within a 10% drop, plus LIVE_TRADING_ENABLED=true and your typed REAL MONEY. do the lessons last forever

No. Both kinds of lessons are built to change. Mistake lessons only count the last 60 days, so they fade unless the same mistake keeps happening (a relapse brings one back right away). Strategy lessons (half size, paused, conditions to avoid) are recalculated after every finished trade, so a wrong one goes away by itself. A fixed rule would stop the bot from ever learning that things changed.

i have about 5k sitting in my schwab account, will the bot use all of it?

No. It only uses up to the real-money cap you set in Setup (your plan is $50), whatever else is in the account. Its checkbook only holds the money and positions it opened itself, so it never touches your other cash or stocks. Before buying it also checks the cash the broker says is available and spends the smaller amount. Kestrel treats Schwab as a cash account, so it only spends settled money there.

what's the difference between webull paper keys and real money keys?

They're separate keys for separate servers: Webull's paper (test) keys only work on its test server, and real-money keys only on its real server. Setup asks which kind you pasted, and if you pick wrong, Test Webull finds out and switches. Paper trading at Webull needs the paper keys and Paper trading happens at: Webull. Real money at Webull needs real-money keys, Broker for real money: Webull, and the same locks as elsewhere: passing paper results, LIVE_TRADING_ENABLED=true and your typed REAL MONEY.

why is my strategy on half size

Because it's been losing so far. Once a strategy has at least 12 finished trades in that account and its average result is below zero, the bot halves its maximum position size: on the swing desk, 12.5% becomes 6.25% of the desk. It's re-checked after every trade, so once the average turns positive it goes back to normal. If it keeps losing clearly over 30+ trades, it gets paused instead.

what if my mac was asleep at 3:45

Then the swing desk misses that day's decision, and after the close the journal warns that it missed it. Positions in a broker account are still protected by stop orders resting at the broker. The day desk's resting stops expire that night, and any day position left over is sold at its first cycle the next morning. That's why the bot only works properly while the Mac is awake, online and plugged in.

why compare tjr with random trades

Because a stop and a 2-to-1 target can look profitable on their own. The placebo buys at random moments in the same 9:35-11:30am window, with the same trend filter, stop and target, so if TJR's setup can't beat it per trade, the setup itself isn't adding anything. That was a real concern: in the 16-year daily test, TJR longs averaged +0.24R per trade, but random entries with the same stop and target got +0.18R.

is it safe to paste my keys into kestrel, do they get sent anywhere

They're saved only on your Mac, in ~/AITrader/.env, which only your Mac user can read. Each key is used only to talk to the service it belongs to, like Alpaca, Schwab, Telegram or Pushover. The app window doesn't hold broker keys, and the phone screen never sees them: keys and settings stay on the Mac. how can i see what i made on one specific day

Open the Trades tab and find the Profit & loss calendar. Use ‹ › to get to the month, then hover over the day for a quick summary (finished trades, how many won and lost, and the account value change) or click it. Clicking lists the trades that finished that day: the stock, desk, when and at what price it was bought, what it made or lost, and why it sold. If none finished, it tells you how much the account value moved because of stocks it still holds. The Day by day table below has every day's numbers too.

does TJR's strategy actually work?

Not proven. On 16 years of daily stock charts, his long setups made +0.24R per trade, but random entries with the same stop and target made +0.18R, so the edge is small, and it shrank after 2018. Shorts lost (−0.24R). As an account it made 13.1% a year against 14.4% for SPY, and 9.0% against 14.4% in 2018-2026. His real method is intraday on futures, so this was only a rough check; the intraday test is still to do. Before Stage 2 paper trades it, a history test must pass: 30+ trades, profit factor 1.15+, making money, and beating random buys.

what's the difference between pause and emergency stop

Pause means no new trades, but nothing is sold: stop-losses keep protecting what it owns, and the day desk still sells before the close. Emergency stop is for when you want out: you type SELL EVERYTHING (in the app, or /kill SELL EVERYTHING on Telegram), it cancels the bot's orders, sells everything it bought (never your own stocks) and halts both desks until you resume. Pausing from the phone is /pause.

what can i do from the phone version

You see the same Kestrel screen as on the Mac: Summary, Positions, Trades with the P&L calendar, Activity, Research & plans and Journal, refreshing every 30 seconds. You can press Pause and Emergency stop (with the typed SELL EVERYTHING), and tap any stock symbol for its company card. Keys, settings and updates aren't there: the Setup button, Full Setup menu and Check for updates are hidden on the phone, and those things are done on the Mac.
